_about: Public-domain Gustav Warneck (1834-1910, Halle, founder of missiology) in English for the Word Hoard: Modern Missions and Culture, tr. Thomas Smith (Edinburgh, 1883), and the Outline of a History of Protestant Missions in Smith's 1884 translation and George Robson's 1901 edition, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
